== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Jawa Blaster (Japanese)|Jawa Blaster]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/sputman1021/imagegallery/47850 Japanese A New Hope PSA showcase], PSA certificate 159081614.

Crop rectangle <code>(133, 600, 1298, 2229)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>ce5ecef0a667d70a17c24da871953369af673fea2105f408862b5488ff2d2d20</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
